name: nlp_keras_text

origin: hardening round 2, domain-nlp, 2026-09-14 - the Keras text stack (TextVectorization + tf.data + a compiled functional model), which round 1's NLP family never covered
note: The correct twin of nlp_keras_text_bad. Zero findings in both dataflow modes on 2026-09-14.
